title: Refresh shard weights from 5 CI runs
body:
Outcome: scripts/lib/shard-weights.mjs holds weights folded from CI, not the lead host.
Evidence: t-aajfaqd added per-file durationMs to KRN_TEST_SUMMARY_JSON and scripts/shard-weights-refresh.mjs; the first refresh needs 5 successful main push runs that carry durations (only runs after that merge do).
Acceptance: `node scripts/shard-weights-refresh.mjs --write` exits 0 with 5 runs, the PR lists the run ids, and the slowest Test shard step in the next main run is compared with run 42420551206 (26 s).
